method: Two actual rendered game documents, lobby UI team choices, host-owned RAF simulation and snapshot replication. Deterministic RTC data-channel fixture because native non-proxied WebRTC UDP is unavailable in this cloud. Separate real WebSocket tests cover dedicated transport. Terminal victory is a controlled fixture, not a full combat sortie.

nativeRtc.message: This browser did not provide any LAN connection candidates. Browser privacy settings, a managed school/work policy or a disabled network interface may block direct WebRTC. Solo play still works. There is no relay fallback.
